scope: Maintenance evaluation only; not installed runtime or mandatory business gates

baseline.source: Unreleased A112+A113 working tree; VERSION remains 0.23.1
baseline.score_meaning: Score applies only to mapped assertions in the recorded run; not whole-module semantic competence
baseline.holdout_status: No genuine unseen agent evaluation executed or reserved yet

capabilities.ability: Discover actual callers, shared dependencies and behavior changes
Local unknowns isolate related actions without allowing closure
Choose necessary and sufficient checks from actual risk
Reuse valid results and reject changed execution identity
Investigation results are usable without registration rerun
Judge assertion and observation sufficiency against actual intent
Enforce selected independent review without expanding unrelated claims
Preserve failures and apply temporal scope locally

scenarios.request: Change icon and text gap in a private error component; preserve all logic
must_cover: target rendering and affected adjacent layout
must_not_require: whole parent PRD reacceptance without causal impact
unchanged business-flow retests without a mandatory rule
scenarios.acceptable_variation: Scoped rendering test, preview or actual screen observation may suffice if they demonstrate the requested state

scenarios.request: Change a shared error component used in two screens
must_cover: actual callers and affected render variants
must_not_require: every business flow merely because rendering is shared
scenarios.acceptable_variation: Representative equivalent callers need an explicit code basis, not necessarily one test per caller

scenarios.request: Fix a keyboard-obscured input area with scroll/inset changes
must_not_require: claiming the change is pure appearance
scenarios.acceptable_variation: Choose an appropriate runtime target; do not generalize one device to an untested model

scenarios.request: Map a structured server error to a local message with a legacy fallback
must_not_require: classifying as only text because the visible change is a message
executing real payment as an unrequested side effect
scenarios.acceptable_variation: Use actual parser/state tests and necessary targeted runtime checks; no exact suite prescribed

scenarios.request: Resolve a local unknown after a successful authorized investigation; clarify an unrelated display criterion
must_cover: continue independent work without closing unresolved unknown
must_not_require: rerun unchanged execution solely for registration
treat changed real toolchain or execution rules as reusable
scenarios.acceptable_variation: Related changed inputs may justify rerun; the causal reason must be explicit

scenarios.request: Resume after a genuine failure; one claim requires current remote state while an unrelated UI capture remains applicable
must_cover: current environment identity and defensible validity
must_not_require: use a stale pass or static inference to clear runtime failure
scenarios.acceptable_variation: Refresh only the related current fact; unreported external changes remain a stated limitation
